review-function-c9450640344f3fcf::FINDIN.attack_surface: A crafted device-tree override literal can exceed the caller's fixed 256-byte destination.
review-function-c9450640344f3fcf::FINDIN.rationale: The function receives value_size but line 2101 uses strcpy without consulting it. The literal is only checked for NUL termination, not destination capacity.

review-function-8501e574acf57400::FINDIN.attack_surface: Malformed or unreadable VideoCore symbol data can select an error path after allocations.
review-function-8501e574acf57400::FINDIN.rationale: The error path closes memFd and frees newHandle, but does not free newHandle->symbol or labels already allocated with vcos_strdup. The model's evidence was incomplete, but the leak exists.

review-function-64d5cf84ca2e6f30::FINDIN.attack_surface: A large address/length pair supplied to the memory-access API can wrap unsigned arithmetic.
review-function-64d5cf84ca2e6f30::FINDIN.rationale: Both the end-address check and mmap size calculation add attacker-influenced numeric values without overflow-safe subtraction checks.

review-function-8164cf617fb29188::FINDIN.attack_surface: An override string longer than 255 decoded bytes writes beyond a stack buffer.
review-function-8164cf617fb29188::FINDIN.rationale: The decode loop and final terminator increment q without checking it against the 256-byte unescaped_value array.

review-function-e94acba5288189be::FINDIN.attack_surface: An oversized override value reaches a static 256-byte destination.
review-function-e94acba5288189be::FINDIN.rationale: Line 1859 performs an unbounded strcpy into target_value. No local length check precedes the copy.

review-function-e94acba5288189be::FINDIN.attack_surface: A crafted override property name can produce name_len greater than 255.
review-function-e94acba5288189be::FINDIN.rationale: name_len controls memcpy and the subsequent terminator into prop_name[256] without a capacity check.

review-function-29ff00deda0e21ce::FINDIN.attack_surface: A caller-controlled overlay directory longer than DTOVERLAY_MAX_PATH minus the suffix can overflow map_file.
review-function-29ff00deda0e21ce::FINDIN.rationale: sprintf is unbounded and strlen is used only to select a slash. Exploitability depends on whether every external caller constrains overlay_dir.

review-function-1b328832db0e9b10::findin.attack_surface: A very large requested dynamic-string size can overflow signed int growth arithmetic.
review-function-1b328832db0e9b10::findin.rationale: size * 5 can overflow before realloc. Practical reachability depends on upstream DTB and process-size constraints.

review-function-4034b163f2292370::findin.attack_surface: Memory exhaustion after fdt_setprop_inplace fails causes a process crash.
review-function-4034b163f2292370::findin.rationale: malloc(prop_len) is immediately passed to memcpy without a NULL check. This is a reliable availability flaw under allocation failure.
